source.title: Bind restarted manual Codex execution to a managed C2 run
source.objective: Managed-run gap in manual/restarted Codex execution: work item wi:853f2846c06d406bb19cf53e20afec5c had executor_started recorded with run_id=NULL and no work_item_runs row, yet execution proceeded and the item was later completed. This allows a restarted lane to bypass C2_RUN_ID/resource-lease tracking. Require restarted/manual Codex lanes to obtain a managed C2_RUN_ID before substantive work; executor_started should bind to that run or fail closed when managed execution is required.
source.next_action: Reassess after Symphony acquisition/migration scope is decided; resume only if the capability remains necessary outside Symphony.
